title.original: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
title.zh: FlashAttention：具备 IO 感知的快速、内存高效精确注意力
title.en: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness

inclusion_reason.zh: FlashAttention 将 HBM/SRAM 数据搬运纳入精确注意力算法与 GPU kernel 设计，成为后续训练和推理内核的基础 Context。
inclusion_reason.en: FlashAttention incorporates HBM/SRAM data movement into exact-attention algorithm and GPU-kernel design, making it foundational context for later training and inference kernels.

abstract.zh: FlashAttention 是 IO 感知的精确注意力算法，通过 tile 化减少 GPU 高带宽内存与片上 SRAM 之间的读写，并给出 IO 复杂度分析。
abstract.en: FlashAttention is an IO-aware exact-attention algorithm that tiles computation to reduce reads and writes between GPU HBM and on-chip SRAM, backed by IO-complexity analysis.

problem.zh: 标准注意力在长序列上计算和内存均呈二次增长，而许多近似方法虽降低理论 FLOPs，却因忽略内存 IO 无法获得真实时延收益。
problem.en: Standard attention has quadratic compute and memory growth, while many approximations reduce theoretical FLOPs without wall-clock gains because they ignore memory IO.

approach.zh: 算法分块计算 softmax 注意力，只在片上保存局部状态并在线归并，避免物化完整注意力矩阵；同时扩展到块稀疏版本。
approach.en: The algorithm computes softmax attention in tiles, keeps local state on chip, and merges online without materializing the full attention matrix, with an extension to block-sparse attention.

system_design.zh: GPU kernel 按 SRAM 容量切分 Q/K/V 块，在片上执行矩阵乘、softmax 统计和输出累积，仅将必要结果写回 HBM。
system_design.en: The GPU kernel sizes Q/K/V tiles to SRAM, performs matrix multiplication, softmax statistics, and output accumulation on chip, and writes only necessary results back to HBM.

key_results.zh: 官方摘要报告其在 BERT、GPT-2 和长序列任务上相对既有基线加速训练，并支持此前难以运行的更长上下文。
key_results.en: The official abstract reports faster training than prior baselines on BERT, GPT-2, and long-sequence tasks while enabling substantially longer contexts.

limitations.zh: 高性能依赖特定 GPU 内存层次和手工 kernel 优化；不同 head 维度、稀疏模式与新硬件仍需重新实现和调优。
limitations.en: Performance depends on GPU memory hierarchy and specialized kernels; different head dimensions, sparsity patterns, and new hardware require renewed implementation and tuning.

workloads: Long Range Arena at sequence lengths 1K-4K

notes.zh: 模型、任务、硬件、基线与指标仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格和部署细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; undisclosed tables and deployment details still require full-text audit.
